evidence_used: Public bug report #2939 reproducer and observed SystemExit(1)/Aborted behavior
J: The failing CLI command and CliRunner are not semantically disagreeing about click.File; the test harness has changed the iterator EOF contract of its synthetic stdin. _NamedTextIOWrapper.__next__ converts normal iterator exhaustion (StopIteration) into EOFError. File.readlines()/iteration legitimately relies on StopIteration, while Click's top-level command handling interprets EOFError as an interactive abort.

required: Preserve normal Python iterator exhaustion semantics for the CliRunner synthetic stdin
Preserve ordinary TextIOWrapper behavior for file iteration/readlines
Do not change click.File or command-level EOF handling
Keep isolated stdin name/mode behavior intact

Sigma: The causal work to remove is the harness-only StopIteration->EOFError transformation. Any patch that leaves that conversion on the readlines/iterator path does not close the cause, even if it masks the symptom elsewhere.
closure_gap: Existing command/file-level handling is semantically correct for real stdin; the missing operator is restoration of the native iterator contract at the synthetic stream boundary.
O_new: Remove the _NamedTextIOWrapper.__next__ override so io.TextIOWrapper.__next__ supplies native StopIteration at iterator exhaustion.
ablation_prediction: Restoring the override should restore the regression.
transfer_prediction: The same patch should repair any CliRunner command that consumes '-' through iteration/readlines, while preserving the upstream Click 8.2.1 test suite.
